evaluation: bridge H20T wide frames through the shipped structural/crack models

dataset.labels: NONE. The dataset carries no defect annotations, so no precision, recall or mAP can be computed; the counts below are what the models said, reviewed by eye on the overlays.

crack_segmentation.native_resolution_note: The app segments the whole frame resized to 1024 px. These rows re-run the same model on 1024 px tiles at full resolution for the first frames. The pixel counts are model output, NOT validated cracks: there are no labels.

visual_review: UNVALIDATED. Reviewed by eye on the overlays: the tiled crack_segmentation pixels (frames 0100-0102) lie along kerb, barrier and lane edges and on a water/sand boundary, not on visible cracks; in frame 0145 the top structural 'Crack' box covers water and bridge deck, and crack_presence flags tiles of lane markings and pavers at p=0.90-1.00. With no labels these look like false positives. Nothing here shows the models find real cracks on this bridge, nor that tiling helps; it only shows tiling makes crack_segmentation respond more. Validating that needs labelled bridge-deck imagery (roadmap item 5).
